text:
jessica_sales: Anne from DeltaSurge - live transcript stream is failing in their Android WebView, client shows JSON parse errors mid-stream.
anne_customer: exact error: 'Unexpected end of input' when parsing response chunks. attaching a small HAR to the ticket.
paul_dev: reproduced on our side with webview — chunks arrive split inside JSON. parser tries to parse each chunk.
omar_se: do they sit behind an internal proxy? could be re-chunking at the edge.
anne_customer: yes, internal edge proxy, no CDN.
liam_infra: quick grep shows a runtime change (2026-02-18) toggling auto-flush after N tokens. that could flush between event lines.
nick_support: short fixes: 1) client buffer until full SSE event delimiter (\n\n) — low effort; 2) infra revert the auto-flush optimizer; 3) offer Dedicated trial to bypass proxy.
omar_se: I'll prepare a tiny SDK wrapper for webview that buffers SSE fragments. snippet: ```js
let buf=''; resp.on('data',c=>{buf+=c; while(buf.includes('\n\n')){let i=buf.indexOf('\n\n'); let ev=buf.slice(0,i); buf=buf.slice(i+2); let data=ev.split('\n').filter(l=>l.startsWith('data:')).map(l=>l.replace(/^data:\s*/,'')).join(''); try{handle(JSON.parse(data))}catch(e){buf=ev+'\n\n'+buf;break}}});\n```
liam_infra: I'll roll back the optimizer in staging and add SSE_WRITE logs (id,len,flushed) to find where flushes occur.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: staging/revert requested by @liam_infra 0m ETA.
jessica_sales: Anne, can Paul test the SDK patch tomorrow? we can also provide a prebuilt artifact.
anne_customer: Paul will try AM PST. thanks.
nick_support: follow-ups: @omar_se SDK PR, @liam_infra runtime revert + logs, @jessica_sales Dedicated trial quote, customer to validate client patch. :thumbsup:
